claims.value: Dayhoff is a protein generative language model using a hybrid state-space Mamba and Transformer architecture with Mixture-of-Experts. It is designed for protein sequence generation, zero-shot mutation effect prediction, and scaffold design, trained on the Dayhoff Atlas containing 3.34 billion protein sequences.
claims.evidence: Dayhoff is an Atlas of both protein sequence data and generative language models — a centralized resource that brings together 3.34 billion protein sequences
This model should not be used to generate anything that is not a protein sequence or a set of homologuous protein sequences. It is not meant for natural language
Trained with an autoregressive objective in both N→C and C→N directions, Dayhoff supports order-agnostic infilling
